interventions.detail: Used Python 3.10 venv (uv) since system 3.12 is incompatible with librosa==0.8.1 / opencv<=4.6 / imageio==2.9.0 pins
Installed paddlepaddle==2.6.2 from PyPI (README's baidu mirror / old versions not used)
Installed setuptools<70 because paddle imports setuptools at import time
Pinned numpy<2 for opencv-python 4.6 / paddle 2.6 compatibility
apt install libgl1 libglib2.0-0t64 for cv2 (libGL.so.1 missing)
Wrap AnimeGAN generator inference in paddle.no_grad() to avoid >12GB memory OOM kill
Downscale input to <=640*1024 px before generator to avoid Paddle CPU im2col int32 overflow segfault on final 7x7 conv
